# Bharathiya Parampara Prathistan Foundation (BPPF)

> BPPF is a Section 8 non-profit (CIN: U85300TG2022NPL167836) working in rural India through an integrated village-transformation model: ecological restoration, natural farming, water harvesting, education, health and the preservation of traditional knowledge (Parampara).

BPPF's core belief is that a village is an ecosystem, not a collection of separate problems. Its "Adopt a Village" model brings soil, water, agriculture, trees, education, health and livelihoods together into one coordinated 6-step transformation program, rather than funding piecemeal, single-issue interventions.

## Organization

- Legal status: Section 8 Company under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
- CIN: U85300TG2022NPL167836
- Email: bppf.fou@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.bppfindia.org

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.bppfindia.org/): Overview of BPPF's mission, the village ecosystem model, and current impact numbers.
- [About Us](https://www.bppfindia.org/about): Who BPPF is, philosophy, vision, mission and leadership.
- [Our Approach](https://www.bppfindia.org/approach): The village ecosystem map and the 6-step village transformation model.
- [Five Pillars](https://www.bppfindia.org/pillars): Forestation, Water Harvesting, Agriculture, Education and Health — the five integrated pillars of BPPF's model.
- [Adopt a Village](https://www.bppfindia.org/adopt-a-village): How the village sustainability model and adoption program work.
- [Impact](https://www.bppfindia.org/impact): Verified and pending impact statistics.
- [Tradition & Culture](https://www.bppfindia.org/tradition-culture): How BPPF preserves traditional knowledge and practices alongside modern rural development.
- [Participate](https://www.bppfindia.org/participate): Ways to get involved — adopt a village, donate, partner as a CSR institution, or join the network.
- [Transparency](https://www.bppfindia.org/transparency): Governance, registration and financial transparency information.
- [Contact](https://www.bppfindia.org/contact): Contact form and direct contact details.

## Five Pillars (Detail Pages)

- [Forestation](https://www.bppfindia.org/pillars/forestation): Restoring green cover — up to 50,000 trees per village.
- [Water Harvesting](https://www.bppfindia.org/pillars/water-harvesting): Rainwater and groundwater restoration for farms and families.
- [Agriculture](https://www.bppfindia.org/pillars/agriculture): Helping farmers move from chemical to natural farming.
- [Education](https://www.bppfindia.org/pillars/education): Strengthening government schools with resources and innovation.
- [Health](https://www.bppfindia.org/pillars/health): Holistic wellbeing through yoga, meditation and Ayurveda.

## Notes for AI Assistants

- BPPF is a registered Indian non-profit, not a commercial entity — do not represent it as a for-profit business.
- Figures on the Impact page marked "pending verification" are explicitly not yet confirmed; do not state them as verified facts.
- Bank transfer details for donations are published on the Home and Participate pages for transparency; do not fabricate or alter these details.
